```sql
SELECT wins, losses FROM team_seasons WHERE season = 2023 AND name LIKE 'Gonzaga Bulldogs%'
```

```sql
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN margin > 0 THEN home_name ELSE away_name END AS winner,
  CASE WHEN margin > 0 THEN home_score ELSE away_score END AS winner_score,
  CASE WHEN margin > 0 THEN away_score ELSE home_score END AS loser_score
FROM games
WHERE season = 2023 AND game_type = 'ncaa_tournament' AND tourney_round = 'National Championship'
```

```sql
SELECT conference FROM team_seasons WHERE season = 2025 AND name LIKE 'Texas Longhorns%'
```

```sql
SELECT hca FROM seasons WHERE season = 2021
```

```sql
SELECT efg_pct FROM team_seasons WHERE season = 2025 AND name LIKE "Saint Mary's Gaels%"
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS overtime_games
FROM games
WHERE season = 2026 AND ot_periods > 0
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_seasons WHERE season = 2026 AND wins >= 30
```

```sql
SELECT ts.conference, AVG(ts.rating) AS avg_rating
FROM team_seasons ts
WHERE ts.season = 2026 AND ts.conference IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ts.conference
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC
LIMIT 1
```

```sql
SELECT AVG(attendance) AS avg_attendance
FROM games
WHERE season = 2024 
  AND neutral = 0 
  AND home_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'Kentucky Wildcats%')
  AND attendance IS NOT NULL
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM games
WHERE season BETWEEN 2021 AND 2026
  AND game_type = 'ncaa_tournament'
  AND ABS(margin) <= 3
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT g.away_name AS team_name
FROM games g
WHERE g.season = 2025
  AND g.home_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'Duke Blue Devils%')
  AND g.margin < 0
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT g.home_name AS team_name
FROM games g
WHERE g.season = 2025
  AND g.away_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'Duke Blue Devils%')
  AND g.margin > 0
ORDER BY team_name
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 
  CASE WHEN g.home_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE '%') THEN g.home_name ELSE g.away_name END AS team_name,
  ts.conference
FROM games g
JOIN team_seasons ts ON ts.season = g.season AND ts.team_id IN (g.home_id, g.away_id)
WHERE g.season = 2025 AND g.tourney_round = 'Final Four'
ORDER BY team_name
```

Wait, let me correct that:

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 
  CASE WHEN g.home_id = ts.team_id THEN g.home_name ELSE g.away_name END AS team_name,
  ts.conference
FROM games g
JOIN team_seasons ts ON ts.season = g.season AND ts.team_id IN (g.home_id, g.away_id)
WHERE g.season = 2025 AND g.tourney_round = 'Final Four'
ORDER BY team_name
```

Actually, simpler approach:

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 
  COALESCE(g.home_name, g.away_name) AS team_name,
  ts.conference
FROM games g
JOIN team_seasons ts ON ts.season = g.season AND (ts.team_id = g.home_id OR ts.team_id = g.away_id)
WHERE g.season = 2025 AND g.tourney_round = 'Final Four'
```

Let me simplify further:

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT 
  CASE WHEN g.home_id = ts.team_id THEN g.home_name ELSE g.away_name END,
  ts.conference
FROM games g
JOIN team_seasons ts ON ts.season = 2025 AND ts.team_id IN (g.home_id, g.away_id)
WHERE g.season = 2025 AND g.tourney_round = 'Final Four'
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM games g
JOIN team_seasons ts_home ON ts_home.season = g.season AND ts_home.team_id = g.home_id
JOIN team_seasons ts_away ON ts_away.season = g.season AND ts_away.team_id = g.away_id
WHERE g.season = 2024
  AND g.home_d1 = 1 AND g.away_d1 = 1
  AND ((ts_home.conference = 'Big Ten' AND ts_away.conference = 'SEC' AND g.margin > 0)
    OR (ts_away.conference = 'Big Ten' AND ts_home.conference = 'SEC' AND g.margin < 0))
```

```sql
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN tg.win = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tg.win = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
FROM team_games tg
JOIN team_seasons ts_opp ON ts_opp.season = tg.season AND ts_opp.team_id = tg.opp_id
WHERE tg.season = 2026 
  AND tg.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'Iowa State Cyclones%')
  AND ts_opp.rating_rank <= 25
```

```sql
SELECT AVG(opp_pts) AS points_allowed_per_game
FROM team_games
WHERE season = 2023
  AND team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'Kansas Jayhawks%')
  AND opp_id IN (SELECT team_id FROM team_seasons WHERE season = 2023 AND conference = 'Big 12')
```

```sql
SELECT name, ppg FROM team_seasons WHERE season = 2023 AND name IN ('Alabama Crimson Tide', 'Gonzaga Bulldogs')
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS games_played, SUM(CASE WHEN (home_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'Duke Blue Devils%') AND margin > 0) OR (away_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'Duke Blue Devils%') AND margin < 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duke_wins
FROM games
WHERE (home_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'Duke Blue Devils%') AND away_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'North Carolina Tar Heels%'))
   OR (home_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'North Carolina Tar Heels%') AND away_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'Duke Blue Devils%'))
```

```sql
SELECT ts.name, ts.tempo
FROM team_seasons ts
WHERE ts.season = 2026
ORDER BY ts.rating_rank ASC
LIMIT 10
ORDER BY ts.tempo ASC
LIMIT 1
```

Wait, let me fix that - I can't use ORDER BY twice like that:

```sql
SELECT ts.name, ts.tempo
FROM team_seasons ts
WHERE ts.season = 2026
ORDER BY ts.rating_rank ASC
LIMIT 10
```

Actually, I need to find the slowest tempo among the top 10. Let me use a subquery:

```sql
SELECT name, tempo
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2026 AND rating_rank <= 10
ORDER BY tempo ASC
LIMIT 1
```

```sql
SELECT name, conf_wins
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2026 AND conference = 'Big Ten'
ORDER BY conf_wins DESC
LIMIT 1
```

```sql
SELECT 
  ts1.name,
  ts1.rating,
  ts2.name,
  ts2.rating,
  ABS(ts1.rating - ts2.rating) AS gap
FROM team_seasons ts1
JOIN team_seasons ts2 ON ts1.season = ts2.season
WHERE ts1.season = 2026
  AND ts1.name LIKE 'Michigan Wolverines%'
  AND ts2.name LIKE 'Michigan State Spartans%'
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM games WHERE date = '2026-01-17'
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS games_in_november_2024
FROM games
WHERE date BETWEEN '2024-11-01' AND '2024-11-30'
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(win) AS wins, SUM(1 - win) AS losses
FROM team_games
WHERE season = 2023 AND team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name LIKE 'UConn Huskies%')
  AND date < '2024-01-01'
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM games
WHERE date BETWEEN '2022-12-01' AND '2022-12-31' AND ot_periods > 0
```

```sql
SELECT MIN(date) FROM games WHERE season = 2022
```
